text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 23,440.8, up 1.68% on the day and 3.02% over the last five sessions, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 1.58% (5‑day +2.93%). Advances outpaced declines (401 vs 92) giving a breadth score of 44.5 in a neutral zone, indicating the rally was fairly broad‑based. The India VIX ticked higher to 15.5 (+1.31%), showing modest rise in volatility.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers, adding ₹3,114.68 cr today, while Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold ₹392.2 cr, extending a four‑day buying streak for FIIs and a two‑day selling streak for DIIs. Leading sectors were Pharma, Infrastructure, Oil & Gas, Healthcare and PSU Banks; IT and Media were weakening. Options data show a put‑call ratio (PCR) of 1.66 for Nifty, with max‑pain at 23,250 and a call wall at 24,000, suggesting some resistance near that level.

Watch the Nifty’s support at 23,284.97 (S1) and the pivot at 23,362.88; a break below S1 could test the 23,200 zone. For Bank Nifty, the key support is 54,707.35 and the pivot 54,876.85. Keep an eye on upcoming RBI government‑dated securities auction and any earnings updates from large caps such as Reliance and IT firms, which could influence the next session’s direction.
